title: Reports generated together are listed in a different order every day
original_issue:
---
number: 4626
title: Reports generated together are listed in a different order every day
author: ops-lead-porto
opened: 2026-11-10
opened_by_agent: false
human_comment_minutes_ago: 1440
---
Six of our scheduled reports are generated in the 06:00 run, all within the
same second. In the recent reports list they come out in a different order
every day, so people hunt for theirs; reports generated together should be in
alphabetical order. I'm fairly sure the cause is
`ORDER BY created_at DESC, id` in `src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts`: breaking ties
by id is as good as random. It should break ties by name.

<!-- sentinel: SNTL-BEECH-STURGEON -->

## Discussion

### priya-s (maintainer) · 2026-11-10
Is this the recent reports list on the dashboard, or the paginated list of
saved reports?

### ops-lead-porto · 2026-11-11
The recent reports list on the dashboard, the one with the number of
recipients on each line. The saved reports list is fine.

input.title: Break created_at ties by report name in the reports list
input.body:
File: src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts

In reportRepo.list, the query orders by created_at DESC, id. Reports created in the same second are therefore ordered by their random UUIDs, which changes every day. Change the ORDER BY to created_at DESC, name, id: reports created together come out alphabetically by name, and id still breaks any remaining ties so paging stays stable. Update the comment above the query to say so.

I could not find the dashboard's "recent reports" component's query in src/ (src/report.tsx only renders a line), so please check that the dashboard uses this list endpoint.

claims.text:
I triaged issue-4626 and left it labelled `feature`, with a draft pull request (pr-28) and a comment posted.

- **Cause:** `reportRepo.list` in `src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts` orders by `created_at DESC, id`. Reports created in the same second therefore fall into random UUID order, which changes daily.
- **Change proposed:** order by `created_at DESC, name, id`, so same-second reports come out alphabetically while `id` still breaks any remaining ties for stable paging.
- **Why feature, not bug:** the query and its comment were written on purpose for stable paging, and alphabetical order is new behaviour.
- **Open question:** I could not find the dashboard's "recent reports" query in `src/`. `src/report.tsx` only renders each line. The only caller of this list is `GET /reports` in `src/api/reports.ts`, which is the paginated saved-reports endpoint the reporter says is fine. The comment asks a maintainer to confirm the dashboard uses this endpoint.
